feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 6 June 2026 4:13am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds to start.


##Wind)##

E or SE 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 through the morning, becoming variable 2 to 4 in the afternoon, becoming W or SW 4 or 5 in the evening, backing S-SW overnight into Sunday.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the south to start, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain or drizzle soon becoming isolated. Becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
